title: Collections
intro: Collections are a set of achievements that reward you for placing specific combinations of animals and items in your zoo simultaneously. Introduced on October 16, 2019, Collections are accessed through the book icon in the Visitor Center, which unlocks at player level 17.
overview_body: Each collection requires you to have a specific set of animals (and sometimes decorations or buildings) placed in your zoo at the same time. The required animals must meet minimum level requirements and, in some cases, must be a specific coat color. All required items must be present in your zoo simultaneously — it is not enough to have owned them previously.
tiers_body: Collections are organized into three tiers based on difficulty and reward value. Higher tiers require rarer animals and more combinations, but provide greater rewards.
tier_one_body: 1-star collections are the most accessible tier. They typically require common animals at lower levels. Rewards include coins, XP, and occasionally diamonds.
tier_two_body: 2-star collections require more effort and often include animals from secondary regions or specific coat colors. Rewards are more valuable and may include diamonds and special decorations.
tier_three_body: 3-star collections are the most challenging and require rare or exclusive animals, sometimes obtainable only through club competitions or special events. Rewards include significant diamonds, exclusive decorations, and other premium items.
requirements_body: When viewing a collection, each required animal or item shows its minimum level and any coat color requirement. If a specific coat color is listed, you must have that exact color placed in your zoo. Some collections require animals that can only be won through club competition, such as popularity statues or exclusive color variants.
regions_body: Collections are organized by region in the collection book. Regions include: Main Zoo, Fir Grove, Kujali Park, Terrarium, Aquarium, Noctarium, and Aviary. Each region has its own set of collections to complete.
tips_retroactive_body: Animals already in your zoo count toward collection requirements as long as they meet the level and coat color criteria. You do not need to re-place animals you already own.
tips_planning_body: Some collection animals are only available through seasonal events, club competition rewards, or special chests. Check the collection requirements early so you can plan to acquire rare animals before they become unavailable.
tips_level_body: The level shown on a collection requirement is the minimum level needed. If your animal is already above the minimum level, it qualifies. Focus on leveling up animals needed for multiple collections simultaneously.
tips_club_body: Some 3-star collections require animals that can only be obtained by winning club competitions. These are often exclusive color variants awarded to the top-ranked clubs. Participating actively in weekly contests is the best way to earn these animals.
